name: The Collector's Bravo
lore: The Tallymen's collector does not walk the Delta's landings alone on tithe-day. He hires a bravo out of the Long Stride by the season, a man with a charter number filed off his rapier and a coat too good for the boards, who walks the landing's round with his hand on the hilt while the eels are counted. He has been told the Delta is soft. He has not been told about the fog.
notes: The rogue's first real fight (docs/FIGHTING_STYLE_STARTS.md 3.4, first_rogue's the_bravo): the Brightwater bravo's hire, a season on the Delta, stood only by that stage (QuestFoes, walking his round of Moreva's landing). His health is sized so that a crouched dagger from behind (the sneak attack's x6, as a backstab) ends it or nearly: 9 x 1.1 x 6 - 4 is 55 of 62. Face to face he parries and thrusts like his Brightwater kin, and that is meant to go badly.
